title: Command Event (v1.0.0)
description: Event written by the backend to bronze when the dispatcher acts. Reuses the turn1-events envelope structure (source: 'backend'). Three event_type values: decision, incident_report, confirmation. The backend is the only writer; the frontend never writes directly. See ADR-0003.

schema_version.description: Envelope contract version (SemVer). Same versioning rule as contracts/turn1-events/.

event_id.description: UUID v4. Idempotency key = source + event_id (same rule as turn1-events bronze).

event_type.description: Discriminator. 'decision': dispatcher approves or discards a recommendation. 'incident_report': dispatcher reports an incident via UI. 'confirmation': driver confirmation status update written by the backend after receiving a driver_confirmation event.

event_ts.description: UTC timestamp when the dispatcher action occurred (or the backend processed the confirmation).

payload.description: Event-specific payload. Shape determined by event_type via oneOf.
Dispatcher decision on a recommendation. Principle IV: no on-road action runs without this event.

rec_id.description: UUID v4 of the recommendation being acted on.

action.description: 'apply': dispatcher approves; instruction is sent to the bus. 'discard': dispatcher rejects.

user_id.description: Identifier of the dispatcher who acted. Logged for audit (SRD §2.9).

ts.description: UTC timestamp of the dispatcher click. May equal event_ts; kept separately for precision.

payload.description: Backend-initiated incident report. Reuses the incident_report payload shape from contracts/turn1-events/incident_report.schema.json. reported_by must be 'dispatcher' for command events.

duration_min.description: Estimated duration in minutes. Null when unknown.

payload.description: Driver confirmation status update written by the backend after receiving a driver_confirmation event from the simulator.

inst_id.description: UUID v4 of the instruction being confirmed.

ts.description: UTC timestamp of the status transition.
